dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Oh, you're interested in our masks?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: It's a time-honored wrestling tradition. The loser must remove their mask, while the victor keeps theirs on, retaining a sense of mystery that inspires others to step up and challenge them.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: As for mine... I've never once been forced to remove it, whether I was facing a human or a saurian.
